subject.title: Add Herdr state bridge for OpenClaw TUI

question: Should Herdr state reporting be accepted as a plugin-gated TUI integration, explicit core-owned TUI behavior, or moved outside OpenClaw core for now?
rationale: The PR exposes a new env-triggered runtime path and a default-on bundled plugin shell, and the right owner boundary cannot be chosen safely from code review alone.

options.title: Gate Through Plugin Policy
options.body: Accept the direction only if startup honors resolved plugin activation, including global disable, denylist, allowlist, and per-plugin disablement.

options.title: Make Core-Owned Behavior Explicit
options.body: Remove the no-op plugin wrapper and document the Herdr env-triggered sidecar as intentionally core-owned TUI behavior.

options.title: Move Outside Core
options.body: Pause or close this PR unless a missing generic TUI status seam is proven and designed first.

recommendation.title: Gate Through Plugin Policy
recommendation.body: Accept the direction only if startup honors resolved plugin activation, including global disable, denylist, allowlist, and per-plugin disablement.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans TUI behavior and plugin policy, both areas with strong history from this owner signal.
